texts.li: At the water's edge {A_nameDef} found {X_indefinite} standing on one leg, and stood there with it a while, both of them waiting for something.
[x:race:Heron] Motionless in the shallows, {X_definite} watched the water so hard that {A_nameDef} watched it too, until the beak flashed down and came up with a fish.
[x:race:Swan] On the still water {X_definite} drifted past, and when {A_nameDef} came too near the reeds it rose up hissing, wings wide. {A_nameDef} backed off laughing.
[x:race:Flamingo] A flash of pink on the gray water, upside down and sifting the mud: {X_indefinite}. {A_nameDef} talked about nothing else at supper.
[x:race:AEXP_WildGoose] Out on the water {X_definite} honked at {A_nameDef} all the way along the bank, like a landlord after the rent.
Down by the water, {X_indefinite} hauled itself onto a rock to lie in the sun, and {A_nameDef} sat on the next rock along and did much the same.
[x:race:Seal|x:race:AEXP_Seal|x:race:SeaLion] From the rocks {X_definite} barked at {A_nameDef} until {A_pronoun} went away, then barked again when {A_pronoun} came back.
[x:race:Otter|x:race:AEXP_Otter] {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} float on its back in the shallows, cracking something against a stone on its chest, very pleased with itself.
[x:race:Walrus|x:race:AEXP_Walrus] On the shingle lay {X_indefinite}, the size of a cart, snoring. {A_nameDef} went round it at a respectful distance.
[x:race:SeaTurtle] {A_nameDef} came on {X_indefinite} hauling itself up the sand, slow as a cart in mud, and kept everyone back until it reached the dunes.
[x:race:HermitCrab|x:race:StoneCrab] {A_nameDef} turned over a stone on the beach and found {X_indefinite} underneath, which waved a claw until the stone was put back.
[x:race:Penguin|x:race:AEXP_Penguin] Along the ice edge, {X_indefinite} waddled after {A_nameDef} for a dozen steps, as if it had been told to follow.
Down at the water's edge, {A_nameDef} sat and watched {X_indefinite} go about its business, which mostly involved the river.
[x:race:AEXP_Beaver] The saplings by the river had been gnawed to points, and {A_nameDef} followed the chips down to {X_indefinite}, dragging a branch twice its length toward its dam.
[x:race:AEXP_Platypus] {A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} at the river and came back swearing it had a duck's bill and a beaver's tail, and that {A_pronoun} wasn't making it up.
[x:race:Mink] Quick as a thrown rope, {X_indefinite} ran along the bank and into the water, and {A_nameDef} only saw the ripples where it had been.
[x:race:Bullfrog] All evening {X_indefinite} boomed from the reeds, and {A_nameDef} went down with a lamp to see what could make that noise. It was smaller than {A_possessive} hand.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a beast of the old world

texts.li: {A_nameDef} came over the rise and stopped short: {X_indefinite}, the kind of animal the old books say is gone, grazing as if it hadn't heard.
[x:race:RG_Dodo] Without the least fear, {X_indefinite} waddled up to {A_nameDef}, looked {A_objective} over, and pecked at {A_possessive} bootlace.
[x:race:RG_WoollyMammoth] Through the trees {A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} pull down a branch with its trunk, and stood still until it had gone, counting {A_possessive} own heartbeats.
[x:race:RG_WoollyRhinoceros] Along the far field {X_definite} grazed, shaggy as a haystack, and {A_nameDef} decided the far field could wait.
[x:race:RG_Megalenhydris] At the river {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite}, an otter as long as a canoe, roll in the current with a fish in its paws.
{X_nameDef} sat with {A_nameDef} at the water trough, trailing {X_possessive} fingers in it, and said the colony's water tasted of iron and old rain.
[land:coast] {X_nameDef} stood knee-deep in the surf with {A_nameDef} and named the fish passing round their ankles, every one of them.
[land:river|land:lake] Before {X_nameDef} would talk business, {X_pronoun} went down to the water and stayed under so long that {A_nameDef} began to worry.
Dry land smells of dust and smoke, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and one gets used to it, mostly.
[hot] In the heat {X_nameDef} kept a wet cloth across {X_possessive} neck and asked {A_nameDef}, quite politely, where the nearest deep water was.
